answer: A newcomer's marble-white reputation starts at zero and only deepens to umber as independent, non-colluding peers attest. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock a unique bond and peer-vouch only for participants it has directly transacted with, so fake identities cannot echo each other into credibility. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus real transaction history, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
